proposedOverrides.summary: This page follows Madagascar as an island region across different political periods. France annexed it in 1896, and independence was proclaimed on 26 June 1960. The map’s separate intervals are not the beginning or ending of the island’s communities.

sharedAssociations.basis: The imported island-wide names and positions support a shared regional history across colonial and independent periods. The selected-year phases distinguish those governments; Malagasy people and Merina polity remain separate records.
